name: sicarius-guard
description: Solana Token Safety Oracle — 7-layer rug pull, honeypot, and market risk analysis for AI agents and trading bots.

token_safety_analysis.note: 5-layer on-chain rug pull detection (mint auth, freeze, Token-2022, honeypot, holders). Read-only, no side effects.

full_7_layer_scan.note: Comprehensive scan combining on-chain checks + Birdeye market intel + Helius wallet reputation. Weighted final score.

honeypot_detection.note: Jupiter DEX sell simulation — zero cost, quote-only, no gas. Returns sellability verdict.

market_intelligence.note: Birdeye API integration for real-time price, volume, liquidity, holder count, and market risk flags.

wallet_reputation.note: Helius DAS identity and funding chain analysis. Checks deployer age, funding source, entity classification.

batch_scanning.note: Parallel 7-layer scan of up to 10 tokens per call. Ideal for portfolio-level risk assessment.

holder_concentration.note: Supply distribution analysis. Flags top-heavy holder patterns (top 1 >50%, top 5 >80%, top 10 >90%).

x402_payments.note: Micropayment protocol for pay-per-scan monetization (0.001-0.002 SOL per call).

rate_limiting.note: Upstash Redis persistent rate limiting — 100 free calls/day per IP, consistent across scaled instances.
